consequence.statement: When JMX is enabled, the JVM default IP address preference now applies instead of the implicit IPv4 preference. IPv6-only clusters now boot correctly.

assertion.statement: The implicit IPv4 preference applied when JMX is enabled has been removed; the JVM defaults now apply.
